description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Flexible, which extends HTMLPurifier_VarParser to perform safe variable parsing based on different data types. The class includes a method parseImplementation that converts input variables to specified types with validation and error handling.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Flexible
classes.description: A class for flexible and safe parsing of variables into specified data types, with error handling.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Parses a variable into a specified type with optional null allowance, performing conversions and validations.
